system.description: You are so adept at a particular form of attack that your foes struggle to shake off the effects. Perhaps the flames of your fireballs burn hotter. Or maybe you've developed a special chemical to mix in with your blinding powder. Whatever the source and whatever the effect, most enemies are incapable of recovering from your legendary attack.
system.effect: Choose one bane that you can invoke that has a duration of "resist ends". When a target makes a resist roll to shake off your invocation of the chosen bane, they have disadvantage 1.
system.special: You may select this feat multiple times. Each time you take it, choose a different bane.

other: Ability to invoke the chosen bane
